comments.author: Joe Mama
comments.body: This ship is overrated garbage. This is the poor man's sovergn. Barely 1400 dura, only 43 base armour and only goes 7/7. Also there is no good second optional skill to put along with WMB. The base turn and wave are low also limiting agility. If rather a FIS over this in all aspects except melee strength. Id wait for the better modified soverign with more dura, 45 base armour and goes 8/8. This also reqs sailing lvl 45 to sail at 5/5 so a full mod 7/7 would req 55 maritime lvl making it very hard for any aide to use for tactical ship swapping potential. This was t even on invyro last week. It was recently added so OGP can make a little more money before releasing the good model of this ship.

comments.author: Llewelyn
comments.body:
Base stats out of ticket:
118 V / 251 H / 1141 Dura
10 T / 8 W / 43 A
62 min 130 max crew (refits to 195 max)
100 gun (refits down to 50)
25/10/35 levels.

SB R 9 for 2nd mod (stock is 1/5 as normal) Comparing with the standard ship the sails and dura and armour all get a small buff, max crew seems to be 6 lower. So yeah, not really that nice of a ship, although battle level 35 stock is better than stated above. Can't see original skills as I don't have any OSP right now.

comments.author: Bombito
comments.body:
This ship is underrated treasure.
Selling for roughly 10-14B in ticket anyone that does a small comparison
between the CSOS and AFCV will see they are really neck to neck.

CSOS AFCV
Dura 1141 1148
Vert 118 109
Horiz. 251 237
Turn 10 8
WaveR 8 7
Armor 43 42
Cabin 195 217
=====================================================
The only important difference that is in the favor of the AFCV is the crew now anyone that has used WMB will tell you that the AFCV even SSC and APN will not outmelee 195 crew with WMB

As for the non melee skills IGP is a much better otption than the non melee skills of the AFCV so before you go and think that 20-25B for
an AFCV is the right price, you may want to get something slightly better for much less which is the CSOS.
